name: Phalanx Soldier
summary: A shield-wall specialist who combines shields with spears and polearms to protect adjacent allies and drive through enemy lines.

features.name: Stand Firm +1
features.summary: Gain +1 CMD against bull rush, drag, overrun, and trip, and +1 on saves against trample.

features.name: Phalanx Fighting
features.summary: While wielding a shield, use a spear or polearm of your size as a one-handed weapon.

features.name: Ready Pike +1
features.summary: Once per day, immediately ready a brace weapon with +1 on its attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Ready Pike +2
features.summary: Increase Ready Pike to +2 and two uses per day.

features.name: Ready Pike +3
features.summary: Increase Ready Pike to +3 and three uses per day.

features.name: Ready Pike +4
features.summary: Increase Ready Pike to +4 and four uses per day.

features.name: Deft Shield -1
features.summary: Reduce a tower shield's armor check and attack penalties by 1.

features.name: Deft Shield -2
features.summary: Reduce a tower shield's armor check and attack penalties by 2.

features.name: Shield Ally
features.summary: As a move action with a heavy or tower shield, give yourself and adjacent allies partial cover until your next turn.

features.name: Greater Shield Ally
features.summary: Give one adjacent ally cover and evasion until your next turn.

features.name: Improved Shield Ally
features.summary: Give yourself and all adjacent allies cover, or one adjacent ally improved cover and improved evasion.

features.name: Irresistible Advance
features.summary: Gain +1 to +4 on bull rush and overrun CMB depending on whether you use a buckler, light, heavy, or tower shield.

features.name: Shielded Fortress
features.summary: Your shield cannot be disarmed or sundered; gain evasion with a shield, improved evasion with a tower shield, and extend those defenses to adjacent allies.
